name: Hidden: Rebuild
author: 2097483+phit@users.noreply.github.com
description: Dedicated server for Hidden: Rebuild, Hidden: Source Beta 4b rebuilt on Source SDK 2013 (https://www.hidden-rebuild.com/). Installs Source SDK Base 2013's dedicated server, Beta 4b and the mod, and updates the mod from GitHub's releases or snapshots on every start.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Hidden: Rebuild dedicated server: Source SDK Base 2013's dedicated server (SteamCMD app 244310),
# Hidden: Source Beta 4b from its official download, and the mod from GitHub.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -e

## SteamCMD and the dedicated server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd /mnt/server/steamapps	# steamcmd fails to write without steamapps
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
chown -R root:root /mnt	# SteamCMD fails otherwise; the panel hands the files back afterwards
export HOME=/mnt/server
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} validate +quit
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Hidden: Source Beta 4b, which the mod loads its content from (kept on reinstalls)
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f hidden/gameinfo.txt ]; then
    echo "Downloading Hidden: Source Beta 4b"
    curl -fSL -o /tmp/hsb4b.zip "${BETA4B_URL}"
    rm -rf /tmp/hsb4b && mkdir -p /tmp/hsb4b
    unzip -q /tmp/hsb4b.zip -d /tmp/hsb4b
    gameinfo=$(find /tmp/hsb4b -maxdepth 3 -name gameinfo.txt | head -n 1)
    if [ -z "$gameinfo" ]; then
        echo "The Beta 4b download has no gameinfo.txt" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    rm -rf hidden
    mv "$(dirname "$gameinfo")" hidden
    rm -rf /tmp/hsb4b /tmp/hsb4b.zip
fi

## Hidden: Rebuild, from the chosen channel; the start command keeps it updated
curl -fsSL -o hidden_update.sh https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phit/hidden-2013/main/tools/hidden_update.sh
chmod +x hidden_update.sh
rm -f .hidden_package	# a reinstall always extracts the package again
./hidden_update.sh

## Linux file names are case-sensitive, Beta 4b's have capitals
sh hidden2013/lowercase_beta4b.sh

echo "Hidden: Rebuild is installed"

variables.description: Update Hidden: Rebuild and the Source SDK Base 2013 server on every start. 1: on, 0: off.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on.

variables.name: Game ID

variables.name: Beta 4b download
variables.description: Where the install gets Hidden: Source Beta 4b from; the official release by default.
